INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – March 24, 2021

The Inglewood Library Board met on March 24, 2021 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 5:06 p.m. by
Board Member Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Minton made a motion for the approval of the minutes for February 24, 2021 and October
  28, 2020.

  All the Board Members approved the minutes.

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh gave the board members Library’s update

    Work at Home order is extended to June 6, 2021.

    Library employees are qualified under phase one B for education and childcare for the COVID
  vaccines. Everybody got a letter for the vaccine and whoever wanted has already started getting
  them.

    Agreement with Overdrive is approved by City Council. That transition will allow us to have access
  to 3000 electronic magazines that we never had available before. 100 of those magazines will be
  Spanish. With Overdrive we’ll get access to an additional 60,000 books from Project Gutenberg.

  1
   That will be added to our digital catalog. Which will give us over 1,000,000 articles of resources
  within our catalog.

    Interviewing for part time librarians. Our principle librarians have identified five staff members and
  are moving through the hiring process. They will start working remotely immediately to be on top of
  our programming.

    Podcast is doing well. We have over 130 listeners and some international listeners joining in too.
  Board Members asked questions regarding vaccine, hiring, podcast and Mr. Singh answered them.

Public Comments

  None

Friends Report
  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) informed the board that friend’s
Group is eager to get back and start having book sales. Hoping for library employees to come back before June 7th
and help them to be ready for the reopening. In the meantime friends done all the annual reporting to federal and
state governments about the status of FOIPL organization and still fully a 501C3 nonprofit and are excited about all
of the charges.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board Member Cochran asked Mr. Singh if library is looking at colleges and universities that have library
programs for hiring librarians.

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh answered that we actually have connections to a lot of the
surrounding schools and we have an intern right now from one of the local schools.

  Board Member Minton asked Mr. Singh about how many applications we have gotten.

  Mr. Singh answered 15 applications for the part time librarian position and 20 applications for the account
clerk position.

  Board Member Douglas made a comment that we had a lot of good information in this short meeting.

  Board Member Minton talked about a project that LA Metro Arts is working on for the new metro stations
and asked Mr. Singh if Inglewood Public Library would be interested in for promotion and outreach.

  Mr. Singh said will look forward to it and thanked for making that connection.

  2
   Board Member Sanders asked if Mr. Singh can provide a Budget, asked about vaccines, book deliveries,
and laptop security.

  Board Member Castillo thanked Mr. Singh for the quick and very informational meeting.

  All Board members were very happy.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:36 p.m.
